title: Service request accepted before the initial key exchange has completed
quote: After the key exchange, the client requests a service. / (but SSH_MSG_SERVICE_REQUEST and SSH_MSG_SERVICE_ACCEPT MUST NOT be sent)
rationale: Violation: SR_AUTH or SR_CONN answered with SERVICE_ACCEPT before the client has sent NEWKEYS following the server NEWKEYS, i.e. a service is started on a request that travelled in the clear. Before the server NEWKEYS this is a MUST NOT for the server (§7.1); between server NEWKEYS and client NEWKEYS the RFC only states the order descriptively, and it is MUST only because strict KEX is active (overlaps STRICT-KEX-NON-KEX-MSG).
